relations.subject: Paulinus of St. Bartholomew
relations.evidence: He studied theology and philosophy at Prague.

relations.subject: Paulinus of St. Bartholomew
relations.evidence: Having entered into the seminary of the missions of his order at Rome, he did Oriental studies at the College of St Pancratius.

relations.subject: Paulinus of St. Bartholomew
relations.evidence: Borgia appointed him his private secretary and financed the publication of many volumes of indology

relations.subject: Paulinus of St. Bartholomew
relations.evidence: In 1800, Pope Pius VII appointed him as counsellor of the Congregation of the Index and as inspector of studies at the Pontifical Urban University.
